caption: Lane A happens once per tool, when it is added. Lane B happens on every turn and shows the agent only the few tools closest to the question. Both meet in the toolbox table, where tools are stored.
How a tool is registered: its description and a searchable database row are created. The highlighted input has a default, so it is marked optional.
Instruction hierarchy. Higher tiers win a conflict; the highlighted tier is the standing rules, and tier 4 is information only, never orders.
Schematic, not measured. Look at the break-even point: left of it the card costs more than the transcript, right of it less.
Flow of one agent turn (TODO 8). The highlighted branch, where the model requests tools, is the part you write; the red path is the forced final answer.
Schematic, not to scale. The conversation keeps a preview and a pointer; the full output stays in the database.
